accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.description: Add and edit the accounts of the current company. An account with entries keeps its type, and archiving hides it from the pickers without touching the books.
accounts.footer: Showing {shown} of {total} account | Showing {shown} of {total} accounts

form.name: Account name
form.currencyHelp: Leave empty for the company currency.

confirm.archiveDescription: It disappears from the pickers. An account with a balance, a journal default or a tax cannot be archived.
confirm.unarchiveDescription: It comes back to the pickers.

journals.title: Journals
journals.description: Sales, purchase, bank, cash and general journals of the current company. The type is chosen once and cannot change.
journals.footer: Showing {shown} of {total} journal | Showing {shown} of {total} journals

form.name: Journal name
form.currencyHelp: Leave empty for the company currency.
form.defaultAccountHelp: The account whose balance this journal is. Create it in the chart of accounts first.

confirm.archiveDescription: A journal with draft entries cannot be archived. Posted entries stay in the books.
confirm.unarchiveDescription: It comes back to the pickers.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.description: Sale and purchase taxes of the current company. A tax that entries use keeps its rate and account and can only be renamed or archived.
taxes.footer: Showing {shown} of {total} tax | Showing {shown} of {total} taxes
taxes.lockedNote: Entries use this tax, so only its name can change.

form.name: Tax name
form.taxAccountHelp: Where the tax amount is booked, for example the VAT payable or recoverable account.
form.priceInclude: The price already includes this tax

confirm.archiveDescription: It disappears from the pickers; entries that used it are not changed.
confirm.unarchiveDescription: It comes back to the pickers.

paymentTerms.title: Payment terms
paymentTerms.description: How an invoice is split into installments and when each is due. Terms that come with the chart are shared by every company and are read only.
paymentTerms.footer: Showing {shown} of {total} payment term | Showing {shown} of {total} payment terms

delays.days_after_end_of_month: Days after the end of the month
delays.days_after_end_of_next_month: Days after the end of the next month

form.name: Payment term name
form.total: The percent installments add up to {total}%. They must add up to 100%.

confirm.archiveDescription: It disappears from the pickers; invoices that used it keep their due dates.
confirm.unarchiveDescription: It comes back to the pickers.

assetProfiles.title: Asset profiles
assetProfiles.description: How each class of fixed assets is depreciated and which accounts and journal its entries use. Once an asset uses a profile, its accounts, journal and method are fixed.
assetProfiles.footer: Showing {shown} of {total} profile | Showing {shown} of {total} profiles

methodsAll.linear-limit: Straight line to the salvage value

form.name: Profile name
form.prorata: Prorate the first period from the start date
form.disposalHelp: Used when an asset of this profile is sold or scrapped.

confirm.archiveDescription: It can no longer be chosen for new assets. Assets that use it keep running.
confirm.unarchiveDescription: It comes back to the asset form.

errors.journal_has_drafts: This journal still has draft entries. Post or delete them before archiving the journal.
